plugins.name: project-sentinel
plugins.description: Project Sentinel keeps long Claude Code runs on track: a status bar, the Control Room panel, Context Autopilot (automatic handoff to a fresh context), Cache Guardian (the prompt cache in view, kept warm on request, guarded against model and effort changes), Operations (work queued for later, decisions Claude leaves for you, watchers that wake a parked run, a Cold Resume Guard), optional permission categories that ask or deny on top of Claude Code's own, a run chain, Frontier Max, a lazy-exit guard, a model per kind of subagent work, subagent limits, Focus view, machine load and Kit, an optional pixel companion.
